## Module coverage {#sec-module-coverage}

Which analysis modules produced output. `absent` is expected for the GEX-dependent modules
on the VDJ-only and bulk routes, and for the single-cell QC modules on bulk data.

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

_mods = {
    "VDJ QC": rb_read('vdj_qc', 'vdj_qc_per_sample_compact.tsv'),
    "Pseudobulk QC": rb_read('pseudobulk', 'pseudobulk_qc_summary.csv'),
    "Sample statistics": rb_read('sample', 'sample_stats.csv'),
    "Clonotype sharing": rb_read('compare', 'cdr3_sharing.tsv'),
    "GIANA": rb_read('rollup', 'giana_summary_rollup.tsv'),
    "GLIPH2": rb_read('rollup', 'gliph2_summary_rollup.tsv'),
    "TCRdist3": rb_read('rollup', 'tcrdist3_summary_rollup.tsv'),
    "Repertoire": rb_read('repertoire', 'repertoire_summary.tsv'),
    "T-cell integration": rb_read('tcell', 'tcell_summary_rollup.tsv'),
    "CoNGA": rb_read('conga', 'conga_summary_rollup.tsv'),
    "Consensus": rb_read('consensus', 'consensus_summary_rollup.tsv'),
    "TCRi": rb_read('tcri', 'tcri_summary_rollup.tsv'),
}
d = pd.DataFrame({'cat': list(_mods), 'val': [int(rb_have(v)) for v in _mods.values()]})
d['hover'] = [f"{m}: {'present' if v else 'absent'}" for m, v in zip(d['cat'], d['val'])]
fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(x=d['val'][::-1], y=d['cat'][::-1], orientation='h', marker_color='#2c7fb8',
                       text=d['hover'][::-1], hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>', textposition='none'))
_rb_layout(fig, "Module output availability", 460, margin_l=140,
           xaxis=dict(title='', tickvals=[0, 1], ticktext=['absent', 'present'], range=[0, 1.05]),
           yaxis=dict(title='', type='category'))
```

**Figure. Module coverage.** One row per analysis module: whether it produced output on this
run. Any module marked absent that should have run on this route points to a failed or skipped
step; check the pipeline log before reading the sections that depend on it.
